title: Aurora Commerce Platform
shortDescription: A high-conversion headless storefront for a multi-brand retailer.
challenge: Aurora's legacy storefront was slow, hard to personalize, and bled conversions at checkout. Multiple brands shared one rigid template with no real inventory visibility.
solution: We rebuilt the entire experience as a headless commerce platform. Shopify powered the backend while a custom Next.js frontend delivered speed, personalization, and a dramatically simpler checkout.
results: Checkout abandonment dropped 28%. Page load times improved by 62%. The new architecture now supports 12 warehouses with real-time stock.
features: Headless architecture with Shopify as the commerce engine
One-page checkout with Apple Pay and Google Pay

title: Pulse Fitness App
shortDescription: Cross-platform workout companion with adaptive coaching.
challenge: Pulse had a basic tracker that users abandoned after two weeks. They needed a true coaching experience that adapted to progress and kept people coming back.
solution: We designed and built a cross-platform app with adaptive workout plans, live classes, social challenges, and seamless wearable integration — all optimized for real gym environments.
results: 30-day retention rose from 18% to 47%. Average session length more than doubled. App Store rating climbed to 4.8.
features: Adaptive workout engine based on progress
Apple Health and Google Fit sync

title: Lumen Banking Dashboard
shortDescription: Operations dashboard for real-time risk and transactions.
challenge: Operations teams were switching between six different tools to monitor transactions, risk, and support tickets. Context switching was killing response times.
solution: A unified real-time dashboard that brings transactions, risk signals, and support queues into one high-performance interface designed for long shifts and high data volume.
results: Average incident response time fell by 41%. Teams reported significantly lower cognitive load during peak hours.

title: Verde Impact Site
shortDescription: Story-driven climate-tech site with interactive impact data.
challenge: Verde had strong data but a weak story. Their previous site felt corporate and failed to communicate real climate impact to both investors and the public.
solution: A scroll-driven narrative experience that turns metrics into an emotional journey, backed by interactive visualizations and a CMS-powered case study archive.
results: Time on site increased 3.4×. Lead quality from the site improved noticeably according to their sales team.

title: Nexus Project Workspace
shortDescription: Collaborative workspace for distributed product teams.
challenge: Nexus needed a flexible workspace that could replace three separate tools while remaining simple enough for non-technical users.
solution: We designed and built their flagship SaaS from research through a production-ready design system, supporting multiple views and real-time collaboration.
results: The product launched on schedule. Early customers reduced tool spend by an average of 40%.

title: Atelier Brand Experience
shortDescription: Motion-rich portfolio for a boutique creative studio.
challenge: Atelier's previous site underrepresented the quality of their work. It felt generic and failed to convey craft.
solution: A carefully paced, motion-rich experience that puts large imagery first and keeps interaction quiet and intentional — while staying fast under heavy media.
results: Inbound inquiries from the site increased significantly. The site itself became a talking point in new business meetings.

title: Harbor Logistics Portal
shortDescription: Client portal for live shipment tracking and documents.
challenge: Clients relied on email chains and phone calls for shipment status and documents. Exceptions were slow to surface and expensive to resolve.
solution: A dedicated client portal with live map tracking, document exchange, e-signature, and role-based views for both clients and internal agents.
results: Support ticket volume related to 'where is my shipment' dropped sharply. Document turnaround improved from days to hours.

title: Echo Podcast Platform
shortDescription: Subscription podcast network with a calm listening UI.
challenge: Echo's shows were growing but the listening experience was fragmented across apps and a basic website. Monetization was limited.
solution: A content-first platform with a custom player, personalized recommendations, membership tiers, and embeddable players for partners.
results: Paid membership conversion exceeded projections. Partner embeds drove meaningful new discovery.
